rules.description: Positive ground unit equality rewrites the whole argument of a positive unary-predicate unit clause.
The fixed f(a)=b, q(X) | p(f(X)) schema, with whole-target substitution.

Accepted exact ordered replay preserves universal clause validity via standardized_superposition_sound, with independent parent freshening, common simultaneous one-step unifier, whole-parent substitution, arbitrary selected indices and explicit target position. Includes a manually encoded executable IR replay of archived SWV406+1:c502; the fixture is not parsed. Complete hygiene/resource refinement remains open. See RULE_CONTRACT.md.

Bounded exact ordered resolution on positive-left/negative-right occurrences of the same 0-ary predicate. Accepted replay proves universal validity preservation; DAG dispatch binds cited parents and conclusion to local entailment. Unit and multi-step refutations certify without empty inputs. No first-order unification or context normalization.
Positive-left/negative-right identical predicate or equality atoms, exact ordered contexts, no pivot unification. Enables complete superposition plus exact-resolution refutation DAGs through wire v1.

Standardized-apart first-order binary resolution with independent parent freshening, common simultaneous one-step unifier, positive-left/negative-right unified atom pivot equation, and exact concatenated resolvent construction. Dispatched in proof DAGs via ProofNodeKind::FirstOrderResolution; proven by standardized_first_order_resolution_sound to preserve universal validity.

Equality resolution (reflexivity resolution) on a negative equality literal: from C | s != t where s and t unify under unifier sigma, derive C sigma. Dispatched in proof DAGs via ProofNodeKind::EqualityResolution; proven by equality_resolution_sound to preserve universal validity.

First-order clause factoring: from C | L1 | L2 where L1 and L2 have the same polarity and their atoms unify under unifier sigma, derive (C | L1) sigma. Dispatched in proof DAGs via ProofNodeKind::Factoring; proven by clause_factoring_sound to preserve universal validity.

Equality factoring on positive equality literals: from C | s = t | u = v where s and u unify under unifier sigma, derive (C | t != v | s = t) sigma. Dispatched in proof DAGs via ProofNodeKind::EqualityFactoring; proven by equality_factoring_sound to preserve universal validity.

certify_dag proves no well-formed interpretation satisfies the supplied universally closed IR inputs. Per-node support includes exact input membership, superposition, nullary and exact-atom resolution. Wire v1 and a trusted CNF TPTP bridge provide opt-in MRS shadow and dual-check APIs. The byte decoder and TPTP bridge are unverified.
